items.title: Massive surge of NFC relay malware steals Europeans’ credit cards
items.description: Near-Field Communication (NFC) relay malware has grown massively popular in Eastern Europe, with researchers discovering over 760 malicious Android apps using the technique to steal people's payment card information in the past few months. [...]
